summary: Tested cursor smoothness fix for KNDP agency website. Verified custom cursor presence, willChange:transform, ref-guard implementation, passive event listeners, and all modal interactions (open, close via X/Escape/backdrop).
critical_code_review_comments: Cursor.jsx: ref guards on setHovering/setDown correctly prevent re-renders on every mouseover — only triggers when value changes. Implementation is correct.
Cursor.jsx: willChange:'transform' applied on both the outer motion.div and inner motion.span — correct for GPU compositing.
Cursor.jsx: All 4 event listeners (mousemove, mouseover, mousedown, mouseup) use { passive: true } — correct.
ContactModal.jsx: Modal close works via X button, Escape key, and backdrop click — all functional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cursor fix is verified. Custom cursor (data-testid='custom-cursor') has willChange:transform, ref guards prevent unnecessary re-renders, passive listeners applied. Modal opens/closes correctly via all methods. The first test run showed a false FAIL on X-button close due to force:True with Framer Motion overlay — subsequent precise mouse.click test confirmed X button works correctly.
